360 :         categories = pd.Categorical(df["Alpha"], categories=["a", "b", "c"])
361 :         df.loc[:, "Alpha"] = categories # error occurred here
```

    applied = getattr(b, f)(**kwargs)

>               values = values.astype(arr_value.dtype)

```

The error occurs because the `setitem` method in the Block class of pandas.core.internals is not handling the assignment of a Categorical object to an Index correctly. In line 867, the code converts the input value to a NumPy array, which does not preserve the Categorical properties. Consequently, when it tries to assign this array back into the values in line 904, it results in a TypeError: `data type not understood`.

Conclusion: The error occurs because pandas.core.internals.Block.setitem is not handling Categorical objects correctly.
